Class StockManagementController

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Thread
be.henallux.project.controller.StockManagementController
All Implemented Interfaces:
Runnable
public class StockManagementController extends Thread
Controls the stock alert background agent.

Follows a producer-consumer pattern: the background thread (producer) writes to the shared resource data, while the Swing EDT (consumer) reads it via getSharedResource(). Access is synchronized on data and orderedData to prevent concurrent modification.

  • Method Details

    • startAgent

      public boolean startAgent()
      Starts the stock-check background agent.

      The agent runs every 30000L ms. It acts as the producer: it writes to the shared data list inside a synchronized block, then calls notifyAll() to wake up any waiting consumer threads.

      Returns:
      true if the agent was started, false if already running

    • stopAgent

    • askStockCheckUp

      public void askStockCheckUp(boolean silent)
      Fetches all low-stock products and their suppliers, then updates the shared resource.

      Acts as the producer: writes to the shared zone inside synchronized(data), then calls notifyAll() to wake up consumers waiting on data.

      For each low-stock product, the quantity already ordered (from orderedData) is subtracted from the missing quantity. Only products that are still missing stock after accounting for pending orders are included in the alert.

      A notification is pushed only if the alert list has changed since the last check.

    • getSharedResource

      public List<Map.Entry<Product,ClientSupplier>> getSharedResource()
      Returns a copy of the current shared stock alert data.

      Acts as the consumer: reads the shared zone inside synchronized(data) to prevent concurrent modification.

      Returns:
      a copy of the current alert list (never null)

    • markAsOrdered

      public void markAsOrdered(Product product, int quantity)
      Marks a product as ordered with the given quantity.

      If the product was already marked as ordered, the quantity is added to the existing value.

      This prevents duplicate stock alert notifications for products whose order is in progress.

      Parameters:
      product - the Product that has been ordered
      quantity - the quantity ordered
